detail: 同一堵簽章牆在 test route 上還在：`ops/ios_test.sh` 記載可用 `--destination` 跑 Mac Catalyst，但沒有對應的不簽章規則，下一個跑 Catalyst 測試的 agent 會撞到一模一樣的 exit 65。目前無 gate 走這條，故列 low。下一步：`ios_test.sh` 偵測 Catalyst destination 時比照 `ios_build.sh` 帶 `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO`，或明確擋下並指向 IMP-0039 的說明。**2026-08-05 取證**:`grep -c CODE_SIGNING ops/ios_test.sh` → **0**(全檔無任何簽章旗標,也無 `--catalyst` 旗標,只有 `:135` 的 `--destination` 全覆寫);而 `:276` 註解自己把 Catalyst 當合法用法寫進 cache key 語意。對照範式 `ios_build.sh:54-56`(理由在 `:48-53`),`docs/sop/ios.md:137` 另記「本 repo 從不簽 Catalyst 產物」。**未實跑 xcodebuild**(唯讀紀律),故 exit 65 屬推論;旗標缺席是實測的。
plan:
CONFIRMED OPEN, and the fix the entry proposed first (just add the two signing flags) is NOT enough -- measured today, so take the second branch the entry itself offers: refuse the destination loudly.
Evidence gathered 2026-08-05 (read-only, no xcodebuild run): (1) grep -c CODE_SIGNING ops/ios_test.sh -> 0; there is no --catalyst flag either, only the raw --destination override parsed at :135 and resolved at :204-217. (2) The blocker is NOT only signing: ios_test_sdk_suffix (:338-344) returns iphonesimulator for anything that is not platform=iOS, so a Mac Catalyst destination makes ios_test_cached_products_ready (:346-367) look for $CONFIGURATION-iphonesimulator/BooksAndVocab.app while a Catalyst build-for-testing writes $CONFIGURATION-maccatalyst/. The run therefore reaches ensure_xctestrun_ready_or_fail (:1224-1246) and dies with "cached test products are incomplete" (main flow :1537-1549), after paying a full build. (3) Catalyst also uses the macOS bundle layout, so the PlugIns path assumed at :353 (app_bundle/PlugIns/BooksAndVocabTests.xctest) is wrong for it too (Contents/PlugIns). Making Catalyst TESTS actually work is a project (product-dir resolver + bundle layout + a scheme that has a Catalyst test action), not a small fix, and nothing routes tests through this path today: repo-wide grep finds Catalyst only in ops/ios_build.sh --catalyst, its test ops/test_ios_ops.sh:1521-1535, the cutover gate ops/worktree_orchestrate.py:393, ops/catalyst_lint.sh and prose docs.

STEP 1 -- ops/ios_test.sh, insert a guard immediately after the destination resolution block ends at :217 (before SCRIPT_DIR at :219, so it fires for --list too and costs nothing):
  if [[ "$DESTINATION" == *"Mac Catalyst"* || "$DESTINATION" == *"platform=macOS"* ]]; then
    echo "[ios_test] error: Mac Catalyst / macOS destinations are not supported by ios_test.sh" >&2
    echo "[ios_test]   1) no unsigned-build settings here: ios_build.sh --catalyst passes CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO (ios_build.sh:44-56, IMP-0039); this script passes none, so xcodebuild would demand a Mac Development identity and exit 65" >&2
    echo "[ios_test]   2) the product resolver is iOS-only: ios_test_sdk_suffix maps every non-iOS destination to iphonesimulator, so a maccatalyst build product would be reported as an incomplete cache" >&2
    echo "[ios_test]   use ops/ios_build.sh --catalyst for the Catalyst compile gate; see docs/sop/ios.md section --catalyst 一律不簽章編譯 (IMP-0039)" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
exit 2 matches the usage-error convention already used at :160-192. Keep the literal string "ios_build.sh --catalyst" in the message -- the acceptance command greps for it.

STEP 2 -- ops/ios_test.sh:276: the cache-key comment currently reads that a genuinely different platform (e.g. Mac Catalyst via --destination) still gets a distinct key, which is the only place in the repo that advertises this route as usable. Rewrite it to make the same point about platform tokens without naming Catalyst as a supported destination, and point at the guard added in STEP 1.

STEP 3 -- docs/sop/ios.md, one bullet under the section at :132-137 (--catalyst 一律不簽章編譯, IMP-0039): ios_test.sh refuses Mac Catalyst / macOS destinations with exit 2, with the two reasons above; Catalyst coverage is compile-only via ios_build.sh --catalyst. Then run ./ops/docs_lint.sh and fix any ERROR it reports on that file.

STEP 4 -- regression case in ops/test_ios_test_discovery.sh (the routed test for ops/ios_test.sh per worktree_orchestrate.py:242), next to the existing --list E2E sections at :265-330: running ios_test.sh --list --destination "platform=macOS,variant=Mac Catalyst" must exit 2 and its stderr must name ios_build.sh --catalyst. Assert the rc explicitly, not just the message.

Today that same command exits 0 and happily prints -only-testing:BooksAndVocabTests (measured), which is exactly how the next agent gets to discover the signing wall the slow way.

MUST STAY GREEN: ./ops/test_ios_test_discovery.sh, ./ops/test_ios_ops.sh (owns the ios_build.sh --catalyst assertions at :1521-1535 -- do not touch ios_build.sh), ./ops/docs_lint.sh. Note the guard must NOT catch iOS device destinations: platform=iOS,id=<udid> and generic/platform=iOS stay allowed and are used by the Release / App Review evidence paths.
resolution: —(2026-08-05 驗證 CONFIRMED-OPEN;落點 `ios_test.sh:135` parse 後 + xcodebuild 呼叫點 `:1077`/`:1185`,成本 S,測試用 `--list`/dry-run 斷言 Catalyst destination 下 settings 含該兩旗標;與 IMP-0017/0030 同檔,單獨開 PR 不划算)
